tracks.name: Gutsy Avenue Grand Circuit
tracks.description: Classic neighborhood sweeper with high overlook summit and suburban cul-de-sac bends.

tracks.name: Maple Leaf Parkway
tracks.description: Wide, fast tree-lined boulevard with gentle rolling hills and double turbo lanes.

tracks.name: Pinewood Switchback Park
tracks.description: Woodland parkway featuring stunt jump ramps, elevated timber crests, and forest chicanes.

tracks.name: Creekbed Canyon Run
tracks.description: Deep sculpted canyon run with steep downhill S-curves and high-banked valley walls.

tracks.name: Arcade Plaza Perimeter
tracks.description: Crisp 90-degree plaza corners, construction pylon slaloms, and long turbo straightaways.

tracks.name: Twin Peaks Ridgeway
tracks.description: Double-summit mountain ridgeway with soaring stunt ramps and sweeping cliffside hairpins.

tracks.name: Foundry Switchback Yard
tracks.description: High-intensity switchbacks with oil slick puddles, hazard crates, and tight drift apexes.

tracks.name: Skyline Overlook Speedway
tracks.description: High-altitude speedway with an 18-meter summit crest, stunt launches, and fast sweepers.

tracks.name: Gutsy Crown Finale Gauntlet
tracks.description: The ultimate Grand Prix finale! Massive multi-sector circuit with elevation drops, hazards, and turbo chicanes.
